title: FootInsights settled football predictions
description:
Every pre-match prediction FootInsights has published since August 2026, settled against the final score, across 60+ competitions from the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and the Champions League to MLS and Liga MX.

One row per settled call: a market of a match (1X2, double chance, over/under 1.5/2.5/3.5, both teams to score, correct score, and the published tips), the call and what happened, the match's 1X2, over 2.5 and both-teams-to-score probabilities, the model's public version name, the settlement time and the permanent URL of the match's prediction page.

Append-only: nothing is edited or removed after publication, misses included. Each monthly release is a snapshot of the file on the 1st; the concept DOI always resolves to the latest one.

  • Column reference: https://footinsights.com/data/
  • Live file: https://footinsights.com/data/predictions.csv
  • Track record and calibration of the same rows: https://footinsights.com/track-record/
